description: Evaluation nationale du volet ferroviaire et transport en commun en site propre (TCSP) des CPER 2007-2013 is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Premier ministre. State of play and typology of projects. Analysis of the impact on RECs of changing contexts since 2006. Assessment of the consideration of initial objectives and, where appropriate, initial results. Coverage: Premier ministre. The portal shows the English title as "National Evaluation of the Rail and Own Site Transit Component (CSP) of the CPER 2007-2013" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Premier ministre. The listing shows 2 download or service links in PDF. The listing shows 2015-04-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
